name: arecipe
description: Recipe-sharing static SPA/PWA on the AT Protocol. No backend.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/main.js && esbuild src/sw.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/sw.js && cp index.html dist/
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
